context: T-6 repo-chain ADR mirror for the shipped blueprints/edge-cloudflare-rate-limiting/contributions/adrs/adr-3701-edge-cloudflare-rate-limiting-throttle-contract.json contribution. An applying Workers project needs a zone-level guard that refuses over-threshold bursts at the CF edge before they reach the origin. Cloudflare's WAF rate-limiting rules provide the native answer with a documented rule shape (id, expression, threshold, period, characteristics, action, duration) per https://developers.cloudflare.com/waf/rate-limiting-rules/. Every applied Worker needs one project-wide answer to the edgeThrottleContract topic; a future non-Cloudflare edge-throttle sibling would conflict on the same topic.
decision: The shipped v1.0.0 default is Cloudflare WAF rate-limiting rules as the zone-level edge throttle. The rule shape matches the Cloudflare documented fields. The edgeThrottleContract topic scope is global on this blueprint. Standards trace clause: Cloudflare WAF rate-limiting rules documented shape.
consequences: The applying project inherits Cloudflare's documented rule shape and platform-imposed limits. Rule state lives on the Cloudflare account, not in the git tree; the local manifest under cloudflare/rate-limits/ is the source of truth. Drift risk is addressed via ADR-3704 (cadence) and TAC-3703 (drift-audit runner).
title: Edge throttle contract: Cloudflare WAF rate-limiting rules (scope global, new topic edgeThrottleContract)
